ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 30-35% high-intensity (white) coverage concentrated in mottling and scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: diffuse speckled mottling across the lower and central field. Right lobe: large high-intensity patch at the distal tip and along the trailing edge, with multiple high-contrast circular clusters distributed centrally.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-notch with an approximate vertex angle of 40-50 degrees relative to the fluke baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by numerous small-scale triangular peaks and larger U-shaped indentations, particularly on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes; left lobe displays a pronounced convex leading edge slope terminating at the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular white pixel rings localized on the right lobe surface, consistent with historical barnacle attachment sites; secondary clusters are visible on the distal half of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal and horizontal light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the dark field of the lower-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant protruding calcareous barnacle clusters present on both distal tips, with heavier colonization on the right tip. Notable deep notch on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'salt-and-pepper' pixel distribution across the proximal regions of both lobes near the fluke base.
